component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
Metanode to create distribution plot of the selected type using the selected column(s) of input table.
Metanode enables input data recalculation to get their cumulative sum per individual column prior the plotting - individual columns data are at first sorted in the ascending order and cumulative sum, ignoring the missing values, is then calculated replacing original column data.
Statistics or data normalization can be done either separately for individual columns or for all selected data combined.
Note: any data preprocessing (like transformation, normalization) should be done prior the metanode usage! The metanode only displays the provided data unless specified otherwise.
